fields.help_en:
The NameID format defined by the SAML protocol standard. Valid values:
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified: Unspecified. The application determines how to parse the NameID.
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress: Email address format.
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent: Persistent NameID.
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient: Transient NameID
fields.help_zh:
SAML协议标准的NameID格式，取值可选范围：
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified：未指定的，由应用自行决定解析NameID。
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress：Email地址格式。
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent：持久化的NameID。
urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient：瞬时的NameID
fields.name: name_id_format

fields.help_en: The validity period of the issued access token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 1200 (20 minutes)
fields.help_zh: 签发的access token有效时间，单位为秒，默认1200秒（20分钟）
fields.name: access_token_effective_time

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the application is allowed to act as a public client to request the IDaaS EIAM authorization server. Only the authorization code mode and device mode support this feature. Default value: false
fields.help_zh: 应用是否允许作为公共客户端请求IDaaS EIAM授权服务器。只支持授权码模式和设备模式启用，默认为false
fields.name: allowed_public_client

fields.help_en: The validity period of the issued code. Unit: seconds. Default value: 60 (1 minute)
fields.help_zh: 签发的code有效时间，单位为秒，默认为60秒（1分钟）
fields.name: code_effective_time

fields.help_en: The name of the returned claim
fields.help_zh: 返回的claim名称
fields.name: claim_name

fields.help_en: The value expression of the returned claim
fields.help_zh: 返回的claim取值表达式
fields.name: claim_value_expression

fields.help_en: The custom user information included in the ID token response
fields.help_zh: 自定义id token返回包含的用户信息
fields.name: custom_claims

fields.help_en: The OIDC standard parameter scope, which specifies the scope of user attributes that can be returned by the userinfo endpoint or the ID token
fields.help_zh: OIDC协议标准参数 scope，用于指定userinfo端点或者id_token可以返回的用户属性范围
fields.name: grant_scopes

fields.help_en: The list of supported OIDC protocol grant types
fields.help_zh: 支持的OIDC协议授权模式列表
fields.name: grant_types

fields.help_en: The validity period of the issued ID token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 300 (5 minutes)
fields.help_zh: 签发的id token有效时间，单位为秒，默认为300秒（5分钟）
fields.name: id_token_effective_time

fields.help_en: The ID of the identity authentication source used for the password mode. This parameter takes effect only when the GrantTypes of the OIDC application includes the password mode
fields.help_zh: 密码模式使用的身份认证源ID，当且仅当OIDC协议应用指定的GrantTypes包含password模式才生效
fields.name: password_authentication_source_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether TOTP-based secondary authentication is required for the password mode. This parameter takes effect only when the GrantTypes of the OIDC application includes the password mode
fields.help_zh: 密码模式是否强制需要TOTP二次认证，当且仅当OIDC协议应用指定的GrantTypes包含password模式才生效
fields.name: password_totp_mfa_required

fields.help_en: The algorithm used to calculate the Code Challenge in PKCE
fields.help_zh: PKCE中计算Code Challenge的算法
fields.name: pkce_challenge_methods

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the application SSO requires PKCE (RFC 7636)
fields.help_zh: 应用SSO是否强制要求PKCE（RFC 7636）
fields.name: pkce_required

fields.help_en: The list of logout callback addresses supported by the application
fields.help_zh: 应用支持Logout登出回调地址列表
fields.name: post_logout_redirect_uris

fields.help_en: The list of RedirectUris supported by the application
fields.help_zh: 应用支持的RedirectUri列表
fields.name: redirect_uris

fields.help_en: The validity period of the issued refresh token. Unit: seconds. Default value: 86400 (1 day)
fields.help_zh: 签发的refresh token有效时间，单位为秒，默认为86400秒（1天）
fields.name: refresh_token_effective

fields.help_en: The response types supported by the application when OidcSsoConfig.GrantTypes includes the implicit mode

fields.name: response_types

parameters.help_en: The SSO configuration parameters for an OIDC protocol-based application
parameters.help_zh: OIDC协议的应用SSO属性配置参数
parameters.name: oidc_sso_config

parameters.help_en:
The initialization single sign-on (SSO) method. Valid values:
only_app_init_sso: Only application-initiated SSO. This is the default value for OIDC protocol applications. When a SAML application specifies this method, InitLoginUrl must be specified.
idaas_or_app_init_sso: SSO initiated from the IDaaS portal or the application. This is the default value for SAML protocol applications. When an OIDC protocol application specifies this method, InitLoginUrl must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
初始化单点登录SSO方式，取值可选范围：
only_app_init_sso：仅应用发起SSO，OIDC协议应用默认取值。当SAML应用指定为该方式时，InitLoginUrl必须指定。
idaas_or_app_init_sso：支持IDaaS门户或者应用发起SSO，SAML协议应用默认取值范围。当OIDC协议指定为该方式时，InitLoginUrl必须指定
parameters.name: init_login_type

parameters.help_en:
The URL that triggers the initialization single sign-on (SSO).
When an OIDC protocol application sets InitLoginType to idaas_or_app_init_sso, this parameter is required.
When a SAML protocol application sets InitLoginType to only_app_init_sso, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
初始化单点登录SSO触发地址。
当OIDC协议类型应用设置InitLoginType为idaas_or_app_init_sso时，必须指定该参数。
当SAML协议类型应用设置InitLoginType为only_app_init_sso时，必须指定该参数
parameters.name: init_login_url

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token
